title: How to Stay Calm When Everyone Else Loses Control 🧠 #mindset #stoic
script_body: When someone tries to provoke you, remember this: silence is the ultimate power. Epictetus taught that any person capable of angering you becomes your master. They can only disturb you if you allow them to. Next time someone tries to test your patience, smile, stay silent, and walk away. You win by remaining unmoved. Want to master psychological control? title: Stop Wasting Your Time on Things That Don't Matter ⏳ #stoicism #motivation
script_body: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it. Seneca warned us 2,000 years ago: people are stingy with their money, but reckless with their time. Stop scrolling mindlessly. Stop seeking approval from people you don't even like. Your time is running out. Make every single second count. Build your dream life before it is too late.
